figmaChanges: Completed the existing student and operator charging screens; previous placeholder content remains hidden for recovery.
Added personal-vehicle registration, network-vehicle registration and an operator schedule-adjustment form.
Reused existing component instances, Ocean Mobility variables, Be Vietnam Pro typography and native editable layers.
scope: UI only. Sequence, activity and state diagram placeholders remain unchanged for later teammate submissions.
modelingNotes: Student registration is for an owned personal vehicle; operator registration is for a vehicle within the operator's network scope.
Priority is derived from battery below 20 percent or planned use within 60 minutes, not freely chosen by the student. Equal-priority requests preserve confirmation order.
An accepted request can remain Pending and is distinct from a ChargingSession that has actually started.
The adjustment example moves Scheduled request CHG-0091 from A4-CS05 to available A4-CS04 and requires a reason, revalidation and confirmation. Active Charging sessions remain unchanged.
Battery, timing, availability and schedule preview values are illustrative static mockup data, not live telemetry or an implemented scheduling algorithm.
The report contains one representative UI per UC; both actor views remain available in Figma without importing all variants.
studentNavbarNote: Same six menu labels and order on all signed-in desktop student screens; active item follows current page. Public Hub lookup remains available.
